magazines.name: MBE-02 magazine box (staggered feed), Rem. M-700 BDL long action
magazines.note: Page: 'extends the O.A.L. of the ctg. by approx. .110"'; outside 3.910 in. No max COAL printed. Product Info page lists it for 30-06-based cartridges, 7 Rem Mag and 300 Win Mag up to 7 STW. Box may need its back relieved to sit on factory bottom metal (wyatts-box-rear-relief-bottom-metal).

magazines.name: MBE-03 magazine box (staggered feed), Rem. M-700 BDL long action
magazines.note: Page: 'extends the O.A.L. of the ctg. by approx. .110"'; outside 3.910 in. No max COAL printed. Product Info page: 'Designed to feed the RUM type cartridges when seating out past factory lengths. It will also accommodate the Nosler style cartridges.' The box-lip removal applies to Ultra Mag calibers ('may be necessary').

magazines.name: Extended length 300 PRC box, long action

requiresModificationIds.name: Wyatt's Outdoor Magazine Box Reference Guide

magazines.note: Page: 'allows a cartridge overall length of 3.830"'; similar to the MBE-3 with the window moved for the PRC. Mortise and bolt-stop work from the reference guide: extended boxes need the receiver and bolt stop altered.

magazines.name: CFE-12 magazine box (center feed), Rem. M-700 long action
magazines.note: Page: 'allows for a cartridge overall length of approx. 3.825"'; outside 3.910 in; 'The receiver and bolt stop must be altered ... same as used on the MBE-3 box.' Product Info: feeds RUMs, Noslers and Normas, and can accommodate 338 Lapua and .378 Weatherby based cartridges.

magazines.name: CFE-09 magazine box (center feed), Rem. M-700 extra long
magazines.note: Page: 'allows for an O.A.L. of approx. 4.000"'; outside 4.070 in; 'The receiver, bolt stop, and ejection port, must be altered'. Reference guide: 'MOST CLONES WILL NOT ACCEPT THESE LONGER EXTENDED BOXES.'

magazines.name: CFE-13 magazine box (center feed), Rem. M-700 long action, factory length
magazines.note: Page: 'allows for a cartridge overall length of approx. 3.710"'; outside 3.795 in. Listed under factory-length boxes; for belted magnums and larger cases.

magazines.name: Remington M-700 LA factory length box
magazines.note: Product page prints no length. internalLength from Product Info: 'RLA – Internal Dimension 3.7”' (rounded as printed).

magazines.name: Factory length RUM box
magazines.note: Product page prints no length. internalLength from Product Info: 'RUM – Internal Dimension 3.7”'; 'will feed Nosler style cartridges provided seating depths do not exceed factory length box.'

magazines.name: MBE-04 magazine box (staggered feed), Rem. M-700 short action (WSM/RSAUM)
magazines.note: Page: 'extends the O.A.L. of the ctg. approx. .110"'; outside 3.070 in. No max COAL printed.

magazines.name: MBE-05 magazine box (staggered feed), Rem. M-700 BDL short action
magazines.note: Page: 'extends the O.A.L. of the ctg. by approx. .110"'; outside 3.070 in; lips altered for 6.5 Creedmoor. No max COAL printed.

magazines.name: Extended length 6.5 PRC box, short action

requiresModificationIds.name: Wyatt's Outdoor Magazine Box Reference Guide

magazines.note: Page: 'allows a cartridge overall length of 2.985"'; similar to the MBE-4 with the window moved for the PRC. Mortise and bolt-stop work from the reference guide: extended boxes need the receiver and bolt stop altered.

magazines.name: CFE-05 magazine box (center feed), short action extended

requiresModificationIds.name: Wyatt's Outdoor Magazine Box Reference Guide

magazines.note: Page: 'Cartridge overall length allowed is 3.00"'; 'does not play well with non-magnum cartridges.'

magazines.name: CFE-06 magazine box (center feed), short action factory length
magazines.note: Page: outside 2.950 in, inside 2.865 in; for WSM and RSAUM. (Product Info rounds it to 'Internal Dimension 2.8”'; the product page figure is kept.)

magazines.name: SA 3.100" COAL (Baney) box, Rem. M-700 short action

requiresModificationIds.name: Wyatt's Outdoor Magazine Box Reference Guide

magazines.note: Page: 'The box allows a COAL of 3.100"'; outside 3.200 in. 'CAUTION: If attempting to install on a clone receiver, make sure the bolt stop can be moved far enough to the rear'. Reference guide: receivers and bolt stops must be altered; most clones will not accept it.

magazines.name: Extended length .223 box, Rem. .223 action
magazines.note: Page: 'We've moved the block back to allow a COAL of 2.430"'. Footprint is the R700 short-action cut; Product Info: 'Designed to still fit a factory length short action cutout'.

magazines.name: MBE-08 magazine box, Win. M-70 long action
magazines.note: Page: 'allows for an O.A.L. of approx. 3.825"'; outside 3.910 in; 'The receiver, bolt stop, and ejector, must be altered to use this box.'

modifications.name: Mill the receiver magazine-box mortise rearward for an extended box
modifications.effect: Lengthens the receiver's magazine opening at the rear just enough for a Wyatt's extended box to fit.

gunsmithRequired.name: Red Hawk Rifles, Wyatt's extended center feed magazine boxes

modifications.note: Wyatt's: 'Mill magazine box mortice rearward ... just long enough for the extended box to fit.' Gunsmith not stated on this page (Product Info says only the Baney box 'requires a gunsmith for installation'). gunsmithRequired from Red Hawk Rifles (Wyatt's center feed boxes): 'Installation requires modification to the receiver and bolt, done by a competent gunsmith.'

modifications.name: Shorten the face of the bolt stop .110 in
modifications.effect: Lets the bolt travel further back so the bolt nose clears the base of the longer cartridge in the extended box.

gunsmithRequired.name: Red Hawk Rifles, Wyatt's extended center feed magazine boxes

modifications.note: Wyatt's: 'Shorten face of bolt stop .110" ... to accomodate extra box length.' coalGain is the box page's 'approx. .110"' O.A.L. extension. reversible false unless the bolt stop is replaced; not stated by the source. gunsmithRequired from Red Hawk Rifles (Wyatt's center feed boxes): 'Installation requires modification to the receiver and bolt, done by a competent gunsmith.'

modifications.name: Remove the magazine box lips (staggered-feed extended box, Ultra Mag calibers)
modifications.effect: Exposes more receiver rail so cartridges are not ratcheted out of the box when the bolt is worked quickly.
modifications.note: Wyatt's: 'it may be necessary to remove the magazine lips on the box to expose more receiver rail.' This is the box's lips, not the receiver feed rails. Gunsmith requirement not stated.

modifications.name: Relieve the back of the magazine box to sit on the bottom metal
modifications.effect: Lets an extended box sit on top of factory bottom metal instead of in its mortise.
modifications.note: Wyatt's: 'The extended boxes may or may not fit the factory bottom metal. The easiest cure is to relieve the back of the magazine box ... Most of our boxes are allready cut for this.'

modifications.name: Block the stock magazine well to use a BDL box in an ADL stock
modifications.effect: Corner blocks glued or glassed into the stock well keep a BDL box from falling away from the receiver in an ADL (blind box) rifle. No COAL change.

source.name: Wyatt's Outdoor Magazine Box Reference Guide

modifications.note: Wyatt's makes no ADL box: 'The BDL boxes may be used, but the stock well will need to be adjusted'. Gunsmith requirement and reversibility not stated.

modifications.name: Alter (lengthen) the ejection port for the CFE-9 box
modifications.effect: Opens the port so a cartridge of about 4.000 in can be loaded and ejected.

gunsmithRequired.name: Red Hawk Rifles, Wyatt's extended center feed magazine boxes

modifications.note: Wyatt's CFE-09: 'The receiver, bolt stop, and ejection port, must be altered'; resultingMaxCoal is the box's 'approx. 4.000"'. How much the port is lengthened is not printed. gunsmithRequired from Red Hawk Rifles (Wyatt's center feed boxes): 'Installation requires modification to the receiver and bolt, done by a competent gunsmith.' Wild Side Precision's Rem 700 extended-box install lists 'Lengthening of ejection port' and says the receiver 'will require refinishing on machined parts'.

modifications.name: Alter the receiver, bolt stop and ejector for the MBE-08 box (Win. M-70 long action)
modifications.effect: Lets the Winchester M-70 long action feed from the 3.825 in MBE-08 box.

effect.name: Long Rifles, Inc., Gunsmithing services: install extended length magazine box

modifications.note: Wyatt's MBE-08: 'The receiver, bolt stop, and ejector, must be altered to use this box.' resultingMaxCoal is the page's 'approx. 3.825"'. Long Rifles, Inc.: 'The bolt stop and ejector blade must follow the magazine as it moves rearward.'

modifications.name: Lengthen the Win. M70 ejection port at the rear and undercut the inside of the bridge
modifications.effect: Lets live and fired cases of a cartridge such as the 300 PRC eject from a Win. M70 fitted with an extended Wyatt's box.

source.name: Long Rifles, Inc., Gunsmithing services: install extended length magazine box

modifications.note: Long Rifles, Inc. gunsmithing service page: longer ejection port at the rear plus 'an undercut to the inside of the bridge feature', which 'allow for cartridges such as the 300 PRC to function without issue as both live and fired cases eject'. No lengths printed.
